issues.description: The supplied file reads loans_c.condonacion4, loans_c.condonacion5_wk, loans_c.condonacion5 and loans_c.summary5_2 without producers in its 501 lines. Later formulas consume lcount_f and aliases such as active_h/active_w, defnew_h/defnew_w and deftot_h/deftot_w whose producers or mappings are not established. Target schemas, population and complete producer-consumer order need author specification.

The first inflation-region join uses summary3.branch_number against sucursal_region.sucursal at line 352. The visible in-file branch_number construction occurs later in sucursales_names at line 391 and is attached to summary4 at line 395. Since the loans_c.comp schema is not supplied, whether branch_number already exists before the first join and how it maps to sucursal remain unresolved.

The datasheet says primary analyses are in Stata, but the package inventory has no Stata driver or export statement. The SAS file ends with only an export-to-Stata comment, while the appendix lists four supplementary analysis targets. The handoff and full output-to-table mapping are absent.

Line 1 uses a Windows A: drive absolute path. The supplied host batch workflow requires a relative or [redacted-path-6fb6a4424d50] path; a relative FA_loans path is supported only after choosing a host-visible working root with an FA_loans child directory and checking its writability.

actions.description: Prepare an author clarification and authorized-access request for the five separately consumed Financiera Ayudamos tables. The datasheet says the lender data are proprietary, but it does not establish a current access barrier for every route.
steps: Request the permitted access/delivery route and exact SAS table names, field definitions, types, identifiers and source-to-table mappings for pagos, altas, comp, origina and score_originacion.
Confirm whether score_originacion is derived from the datasheet's credit-bureau file and whether origina and altas are distinct required loan-originating tables.

Request actual source periods and population filters; for dated payment/performance inputs, specify coverage needed for the 78 monthly bins and lagged neighborhood measures without inferring dates from the estimation sample.
validation: After authorized inputs are staged, perform bounded metadata/readability checks for every table and compare all consumed fields and identifiers; validate population and historical coverage separately.

Obtain the full producer-consumer order, additional columns and history for the four tables, including the provenance of lcount_f and the active_h/active_w, defnew_h/defnew_w and deftot_h/deftot_w aliases.
Preserve separate home/work branches and obtain the authors' explicit producer and schema mapping before any table-name or variable-alias change.
validation: Compare each supplied producer's actual output schema with the next merge and formulas in Data_code_GP.sas; verify every mandatory branch and lag window is covered.

validation: Compare actual summary3 and sucursal_region key types/values, then verify the producer precedes every consumer and that region joins retain expected rows.

review_notes: This is a full-pipeline assessment. No analysis_only scope is supported: the release includes no prepared estimation dataset or runnable Stata entry point, and the SAS program has no executable export statement.
Appendix IA.1-IA.4 are reported analysis targets, but their Stata entry points are absent from the package inventory.
The source path is a Windows A: drive literal. A relative FA_loans path is conditional on choosing a host-visible, writable project root containing that directory; no source edit was applied.

All 48 frozen dependency IDs are reviewed. In-code outputs are classified as generated only when the supplied file contains their producer; all 14 external direct table reads have separate mandatory requirements.
The 78 monthly bins are indexed from 01jan2008 and the default branches use one-to-four-month lags; this does not establish full input-source coverage or history before the constructed windows.

The first sucursal_region merge uses summary3.branch_number before the visible in-file producer. The loans_c.comp input schema is missing, so this remains an unresolved producer/key-order contract, not a definite runtime defect.
The source ends at a comment about exporting to Stata. Appendix IA.1-IA.4 are reported targets, but their analysis entry points are absent.
PROC EXPAND is documented as SAS/ETS. No SAS/STAT dependency is inferred from PROC MEANS, PROC SORT or PROC SQL.

Catalog queries returned no candidates for the searched resources; this is discovery only and does not establish unavailable data or missing licenses. No data were downloaded and no author code was run.

The GeoPostcodes page documents a candidate commercial Mexico product and its postcode/coordinate fields, but full-data acquisition terms/current entitlement remain unverified; no access barrier is inferred.
